subject: MAP: Integration deliverables & owner roll-up (SDK streaming/tool-calls)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
To: Devon Chu <devon@medisync.ai>, Alyssa Park <alyssa@medisync.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Integration deliverables & owner roll-up (SDK streaming/tool-calls)

Thanks again for the call today — great alignment on the high-level goals. Per our discussion, I put together a short MAP milestone draft focused on the integration build. Please review and confirm owners/timing so we can lock the plan into the mutual action plan this week.

Call summary (2/3):
- Goal: Production-ready SDK integration with streaming and tool-calling support; structured output for triage/EMR ingestion.
- Target production canary: 2026-12-15 (customer-requested).

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
1) SDK onboarding (client + auth) — owner: Ben Carter (Redwood) / MediSync engineer: Alyssa Park. Target: 2026-11-15. Dependencies: API key + sandbox endpoint from MediSync, network allowlist.
2) Streaming & continuous-session tests — owner: Jordan Blake (Redwood). Target: 2026-11-29. Dependencies: test corpus, sequence length expectations, KV cache policy decision.
3) Tool-calling (internal triage webhooks) & structured output schema — owners: Jordan Blake (Redwood) + MediSync lead eng (TBD). Target: 2026-12-06. Dependencies: final schema, webhook auth.
4) Canary + load test run — owner: MediSync ops + Redwood SRE. Target: 2026-12-15. Dependencies: Dedicated capacity slot or hosted burst window, traffic profile.

Immediate asks:
- Please confirm (A) the listed owners on your side, (B) that target dates are achievable, and (C) who should receive sandbox credentials.
- If procurement needs a copy of the MAP or a short MOU, loop them here — I can share a one-page MOU draft.

Attachments: integration_map_v1.pdf (diagram + milestone table), sdk_prereq_checklist.xlsx (environment checklist).

Next steps:
- Once you confirm owners I’ll update the MAP and send a signed one-page MOU for legal sign-off.

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0199
From: Devon Chu <devon@medisync.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alyssa Park <alyssa@medisync.ai>, procurement@medisync.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration deliverables & owner roll-up (SDK streaming/tool-calls)

Thanks Neha — this is helpful. Quick notes from our side:
- Owners: Alyssa will be primary for SDK onboarding (she’s CC’d). I’ll nominate our backend lead (Ravi Shah) for the tool-calling/schema piece — I’ll confirm his availability by EOD Tuesday.
- Dates: 11/15 for SDK onboarding is tight but possible if we get sandbox creds and a short integration checklist by end of day Thursday (11/4). Streaming target 11/29 is OK but we may need a one-week buffer if our QA windows clash with holidays.
- Procurement: looping them now (procurement@medisync.ai). They’ll likely ask for the MOU + data handling summary and SOC 2 attestation.

Can you also confirm whether Redwood needs any special network config (IP allowlist vs. VPC peering)? If there’s a recommended preference for hosted vs. dedicated for the canary, flag that in the MAP.

Appreciate the quick follow-up.

—Devon
Devon Chu | Head of Partnerships, MediSync Health
devon@medisync.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Devon Chu <devon@medisync.ai>, Alyssa Park <alyssa@medisync.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration deliverables & owner roll-up (SDK streaming/tool-calls)

Appended a brief technical owner readout and a first-pass task list (see attached PDF and checklist). High level responses to Devon’s questions:

Network/config:
- Preferred: allowlist outbound to Redwood hosted endpoints (simpler).
- Optional for more isolation: VPC peering for private deployment (requires infra lead alignment).

SDK onboarding (Ben / Alyssa) — tasks:
- Share sandbox API key + base URL (MediSync).
- Install client SDK (npm/pip) and run the sample send/receive.
- Validate token refresh flows and error codes.
- Confirm token TTL and rotation policy.

Streaming (Jordan / MediSync QA) — tasks:
- Run 1:1 streaming test harness (we’ll provide harness).
- Verify KV cache behavior for multi-turn flows, and evaluate latency at typical message sizes.

Tool-calling & structured outputs — tasks:
- Agree final JSON schema for triage payloads (we attached a proposed schema in integration_map_v1.pdf).
- Implement webhook auth (HMAC) and example payloads.

Attachments included: integration_map_v1.pdf (owner table + sequence diagrams), sdk_prereq_checklist.xlsx (env checklist). I’ve also included inline examples of the webhook header we expect.

If you want, Jordan and I can host a 30-minute tech sync mid-week to walk through the checklist and get Alyssa/Ravi unblocked.

—Ben Carter
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: MAP: Integration deliverables & owner roll-up (SDK streaming/tool-calls)

Quick leadership note — thanks everyone for the detailed inputs. From a deal / resourcing perspective we want to keep the 2026-12-15 canary as a hard milestone but are flexible on intermediate buffers. Action items from my side:

- Legal / procurement: I uploaded a one-page MOU (mou-draft-20261103.docx) to the Drive link Neha shared and started a DocuSign envelope for initial commercial terms. Devon/procurement: please confirm the contact who will review.
- Owners: Alyssa confirmed for SDK. Devon to confirm Ravi for tool-calls by EOD 11/03 (Devon: still need that confirmation).
- Resourcing: Redwood will allocate a 0.5 FTE support window for a 2-week canary (SRE standby) and a dedicated SE for onboarding (Ben + Jordan split).

Marissa asks: can we have all owners and sandbox access confirmed by COB Monday 11/15? If yes, I’ll instruct legal to prioritize the MOU and we’ll schedule the tech canary slot.
